findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "submit_enquiry" is 851 chars, far longer than this server's median (153). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Submits an enquiry to Malta Work Permit Checker — NOT a purchase, NOT a guaranteed quote. Step 1: call with the answers (keyed by field key from enquiry_fields)…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_enquiry · Private data: submit_enquiry · Public sink: submit_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_enquiry · Private data: submit_enquiry · Public sink: submit_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "submit_enquiry" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
